info.scriptSrcText: property this, reflashglobal gPausedon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  this.locV = -1000  puppetSound(2, member(30, "Sfx"))  reflash = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    if this.locV = -1000 then      X = random(200)      if X = 50 then        this.locH = random(512)        this.locV = 123 + (random(3) * 50)        this.blend = 100      end if    end if    if this.blend > 0 then      if (this.blend = 40) and (reflash = 0) then        this.blend = 100        reflash = 1      end if      if this.blend > 10 then        this.blend = this.blend - 10      else        puppetSound(2, member(31, "Sfx"))        this.blend = 0        this.locV = -1000        reflash = 0      end if    end if    if soundBusy(2) = 0 then      puppetSound(2, member(30, "Sfx"))    end if  end ifend
info.name: Lightning
